Hello @lilitkarapetyan ,  `MessageCreator` takes a prop called `customizeTemplate`.  This modifies the template, potentially setting default values, or populating drop-downs.

Here is an example of `customizeTemplate` from `SupportPanel`:

issues.title: Use <JsonEditor> in <MessageCreator>
issues.body:
I've modified `<JsonEditor>` to allow external modules to modify the template.  This allows, for example, the dropdown list of assets in a form to be created from the actual assets in the game.

But, `<MessageCreator>` uses it's own `new JSONEditor()` code to create the editor control.

We should switch this class to use `<JsonEditor>` instead.

Note: when we do this, we will need to modify `<JsonEditor>` to make the `messageContent` and `messageId` optional.  When `messageId` is missing, we should provide a `_.uniqueID` value for it in `JsonEditor`.  **Update:** - hold on, we probably won't create the `_,.uniqId` - because that comes from PouchDb when we push the new document.
